title: “Perfume sample” kidnapping scare
description: A text forward claiming kidnappers drug women with perfume samples, traced from a 2001 email hoax.

input.text: Please be careful ladies! Some men are standing at filling stations and malls giving women free perfume samples. Once you smell it you will faint and they will kidnap you and harvest your organs. Many women have gone missing. Please share this with every woman you know. Don't take anything from strangers!

variants.text: A long-standing internet urban legend claiming strangers are approaching women in parking lots and offering samples of discounted perfume as a pretext for drugging and robbing them continues to be shared widely across social media. U’ll pass out so they can kidnap, rob or do worse things to u. This happened in more than 3 well known malls (sic),” the message says.

verdict.summary: The message warns that women may be kidnapped after smelling free perfume samples at filling stations and malls. This claim has circulated since at least 2001 in various forms, including email, SMS, WhatsApp, and social media. Listed fact-checks from 2001 to 2026 address the same perfume-sample warning and do not verify the kidnapping claim.
whatChanged: No changes recorded along the lineage.

verdict.replyCard: Hi everyone, I looked into the message about free perfume samples at malls and filling stations. This warning has been shared for many years, and the fact-checks I found do not confirm these incidents. Please stay cautious, but there is no verified evidence for this specific claim.
